description: This file defines the VideoPlayerActivity class, an Android activity demonstrating full-screen video playback with UI controls and system UI flags, including inner Content class managing full-screen video behavior.

classes.name: VideoPlayerActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling video playback UI with system UI flags, action bar tabs, options menu, and inner content view management.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner static class extending ImageView, managing full-screen UI flags, system UI visibility, and user interaction for a video display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets full-screen feature, content layout, action bar tabs, and inner Content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu, sets up search view listener, and share action provider with shared intent.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections for toggling action bar tabs visibility.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search query text change events.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Handles search query submissions, showing a toast.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles action bar tab selection events.
